title: SDG 12 責任消費及生產
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #12 Responsible Consumption 責任消費及生產

strip.en: days of drinking water for one T-shirt
strip.zh: 一件 T 恤＝喝 900 天的水

lines.en: This is my third year of teaching in Changhua.
lines.zh: 這是我在彰化教書的第三年。

lines.en: Today we ask one question: do I really need it?
lines.zh: 今天我們只問一個問題：我真的需要它嗎？

slides.ask_en: Wave your hand and say: Hello, Dom!
Look at your shirt. Do you know which country made it?
slides.ask_zh: 看看你身上的衣服。你知道它是哪個國家做的嗎？

prompts.en: Stand up if you brought your own water bottle today.
prompts.zh: 今天有帶自己水壺的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if your school bag is older than one year.
prompts.zh: 書包用超過一年的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you ever fixed something instead of buying new.
prompts.zh: 修好東西繼續用、沒買新的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Still standing? You are already doing SDG 12.
slides.punch_zh: 還站著的人，你已經在做 SDG 12 了。

slides.head_zh: 做給我看：需要 vs 想要
slides.say_en: I need it. / I want it.

slides.head_en: days of drinking water — for ONE T-shirt
slides.head_zh: 一件 T 恤，等於一個人喝 900 天的水
slides.body_en: Growing the cotton, making the cloth, dyeing it — about 2,700 litres in all.
slides.body_zh: 種棉花、做布、染色，全部加起來大約 2,700 公升。
slides.ask_en: How many T-shirts are in your wardrobe at home?
slides.ask_zh: 你家衣櫃裡有幾件 T 恤？

slides.head_en: Where Does Your Pencil Come From?
slides.body_en: A tree grew for years. A truck carried the wood. A factory cut it and added the lead. A ship, a shop, your pencil case. Then one day — the bin.
slides.body_zh: 一棵樹長了好幾年，卡車載走木頭，工廠切開它、裝上筆芯，再經過船、商店，最後到你的鉛筆盒。然後有一天——垃圾桶。

slides.q_en: Your pencil is still long, but you want a new one. What is the best choice?
slides.q_zh: 你的鉛筆還很長，但你想要一支新的。最好的選擇是？

options.en: Use this one until it is short

slides.explain_en: Using what you already have is the greenest choice of all.
slides.explain_zh: 把已經有的東西用完，是最環保的選擇。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Recycling is better than not buying it at all.
items.zh: 回收比「一開始就不買」還要好。
items.note_en: Not buying it is best. Recycling still uses energy.
items.note_zh: 不買最好。回收還是要用掉能源。

items.en: A dirty lunch box can go in the recycling bin.
items.zh: 髒髒的便當盒可以直接丟回收桶。
items.note_en: Rinse it first, or the whole bag may be thrown away.
items.note_zh: 要先沖乾淨，不然整袋可能都被當垃圾丟掉。

items.en: Things that still work can be given to someone else.
items.zh: 還能用的東西可以送給別人。
items.note_en: Your old book is someone's new book.
items.note_zh: 你的舊書，是別人的新書。

items.en: One class of children is too small to make a difference.
items.zh: 一個班的小朋友太少了，改變不了什麼。
items.note_en: Let's do the maths on the next slide.

slides.head_en: plastic bags from one class in one week
slides.head_zh: 一個班一個星期用掉 125 個塑膠袋
slides.body_en: 25 students × 1 bag a day × 5 days = 125 bags.
slides.ask_en: What if every one of you brought a bag from home instead?
slides.ask_zh: 如果你們每個人都自己從家裡帶袋子呢？

steps.en: Make a circle with your arms
Hold it up like a treasure
steps.zh: 像捧著寶物一樣舉起來

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many things you can use again in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「可以再用的東西」越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：15 個

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me the one thing you will change.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我你決定要改變的那一件事。

items.en: Ask "Do I need it?" before I buy.
items.zh: 買之前先問：我真的需要嗎？

items.en: Use my pencil until it is short.
Bring my own bottle and bag.
I want it — but I don't need it.

slides.head_zh: 加碼：再用一次，還是回收？

items.zh: 還穿得下的 T 恤

slides.q_en: Which uses the LEAST water to make?
slides.q_zh: 下面哪一個，做出來用掉的水最少？

options.zh: 一件新的棉 T 恤
姊姊穿過的舊 T 恤

slides.explain_en: An old shirt uses zero new water. The greenest T-shirt is the one that already exists.
slides.explain_zh: 舊衣服不用任何新的水。最環保的 T 恤，就是已經存在的那一件。

slides.head_zh: 畫一張圖或寫一句話給 Dom
slides.body_en: Ask your teacher to open our School Tour page and find the Nanzhou Elementary column. Tell me one thing you will use again.
slides.body_zh: 請老師打開我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到南州國小那一欄，告訴我一件你要再用一次的東西。

slides.big_en:
Do I need it?
Ask it every day.
slides.big_zh:
我真的需要嗎？
每天都問自己一次。
